3: v17.0 bundles the v16.1 through v17.0 AI-assisted generated-code patch roadmap into one packaged release. Eidolon can now translate a task into a concrete code patch objective, extract focused code context, build a bounded patch prompt, parse generated edit objects, check edit consistency, run an AI patch dry-run, classify failures, store learning notes, and run a one-task AI-assisted human-approved code patch loop. The gremlin is now allowed to suggest edits, but only through a cage made of JSON, approval binding, expected text, and the crushing weight of consequences.
